seed: Objects of type `player` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [wall] show mixed outcomes: no_change x3, x x2, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Twin colour-10 4x4 blocks move together: A1/A2 y-/+4, A3 apart / A4 together, mirrored by side.
A move succeeds only if the destination 4x4 is all floor colour 5 (own cells excepted). This explains the mixed player-A3 outcomes; click position does not matter for A3, and gone is only renaming.
Click colour 9 marker arms (blocks->1, marker->11 active), click player 1 disarms; while armed, arrows move the active marker cell by 4.
HUD: colour-0 bars at row 0 (right-aligned) and row 63 (left-aligned), width (128a+150)//300; a = actions this level, kept in a memo of recently returned frames.
Unconfirmed: what triggers a level reset, and the bar law past the observed range.
